info.title: Micropod API
info.description:
## micropod.v1.MicropodService

The Micropod management API: container/image/volume/network operations on
 the Apple `container` runtime, served by the connect-go API server and
 consumable from any connect client (Go, Swift, TS, …).

post.description: Create a container without starting it (docker create).
Remove a container. Running containers require force.
Remove an image. Images in use require force.
Run a command inside a running container and return its output.
Point-in-time resource usage for all running containers.
Pull an image, streaming progress events.
Stop a running container (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after the grace period).

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

id.title: id
id.description: The container ID; `container` uses the user-assigned name as the ID.

image.title: image
image.description: Image reference the container was created from.

state.title: state
state.description: Lifecycle state: running, stopped, exited, created, ...

networks.title: networks
networks.description: Names of networks the container is attached to.

ipv4Address.title: ipv4_address
ipv4Address.description: Resolved IPv4 address on the container network, if running.

rosetta.title: rosetta
rosetta.description: Runs x86_64 binaries via Rosetta translation.

useInit.title: use_init
useInit.description: An init process runs as PID 1 inside the container.

ssh.title: ssh
ssh.description: SSH access is enabled for the container.

virtualization.title: virtualization
virtualization.description: Uses full virtualization rather than the container runtime path.

runtimeHandler.title: runtime_handler
runtimeHandler.description: OCI runtime handler in use, if any.

exitCode.title: exit_code
exitCode.description: Exit code once the container has stopped.

micropod.v1.Container.title: Container
micropod.v1.Container.description: Curated view of a container, mapped from `container list --format json`.

id.title: id
id.description: Container ID — `container` uses the user-assigned name as the ID.

micropod.v1.ContainerRef.title: ContainerRef
micropod.v1.ContainerRef.description: Reference to an existing container (or the ID returned by run/create).

cpuPercent.title: cpu_percent
cpuPercent.description: CPU usage as a percentage of one core.

networkRxBytes.title: network_rx_bytes
networkRxBytes.description: Bytes received over the container network.

networkTxBytes.title: network_tx_bytes
networkTxBytes.description: Bytes transmitted over the container network.

blockReadBytes.title: block_read_bytes
blockReadBytes.description: Bytes read from the block device.

blockWriteBytes.title: block_write_bytes
blockWriteBytes.description: Bytes written to the block device.

pids.title: pids
pids.description: Number of processes inside the container.

micropod.v1.ContainerStats.title: ContainerStats
micropod.v1.ContainerStats.description: Per-container resource counters within a StatsSnapshot.

internal.title: internal
internal.description: Isolate the network from external traffic.

subnet.title: subnet
subnet.description: IPv4 CIDR for the network, e.g. "192.168.100.0/24".

options.title: options
options.description: Driver options passed through to the network plugin.

options.title: options
options.description: Driver options passed through to the volume driver.

force.title: force
force.description: Remove even if the container is still running.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Image reference or digest to remove.

force.title: force
force.description: Remove even if containers reference the image.

active.title: active
active.description: Objects currently referenced by a running workload.

sizeBytes.title: size_bytes
sizeBytes.description: On-disk size of the category in bytes.

reclaimableBytes.title: reclaimable_bytes
reclaimableBytes.description: Bytes freed if inactive objects were pruned.

totalReclaimableBytes.title: total_reclaimable_bytes
totalReclaimableBytes.description: Bytes reclaimable by pruning across all categories.

micropod.v1.DiskUsage.title: DiskUsage
micropod.v1.DiskUsage.description: Disk usage, mapped from `container system df`.

id.title: id
id.description: Container ID (or name) to exec into.

command.title: command
command.description: Command to run inside the container.

env.title: env
env.description: Extra environment variables as KEY=value pairs.

output.title: output
output.description: Combined stdout (and stderr when not separable) of the command.

exitCode.title: exit_code
exitCode.description:
Guest process exit code. 0 on success; when the native runtime backend
 is active this is the real exit status rather than a CLI approximation.

error.title: error
error.description: Guest stderr, when the backend can separate the streams.

snapshot.title: snapshot
snapshot.description: One stats snapshot covering every running container.

names.title: names
names.description: All tags/references pointing at this image.

micropod.v1.Image.title: Image
micropod.v1.Image.description: Curated view of a local image, mapped from `container image list --verbose`.

micropod.v1.ImageVariant.title: ImageVariant
micropod.v1.ImageVariant.description: One platform variant of a multi-arch image.

images.title: images
images.description: Every local image, in `container image list` order.

networks.title: networks
networks.description: Every container network, in `container network list` order.

volumes.title: volumes
volumes.description: Every volume, in `container volume list` order.

text.title: text
text.description: A single line of container output.

micropod.v1.Mount.title: Mount
micropod.v1.Mount.description: A volume or bind mount inside the container.

plugin.title: plugin
plugin.description: Network plugin backing this network, e.g. "vmnet".

ipv6Subnet.title: ipv6_subnet
ipv6Subnet.description: IPv6 CIDR of the network, if any.

builtin.title: builtin
builtin.description: True for runtime-managed networks that cannot be deleted.

micropod.v1.Network.title: Network
micropod.v1.Network.description: Curated network, mapped from `container network list`.

hostIp.title: host_ip
hostIp.description: Host interface IP to bind (empty = all interfaces).

micropod.v1.PortMapping.title: PortMapping
micropod.v1.PortMapping.description: A published port mapping between host and container.

line.title: line
line.description: Human-readable progress text from the registry pull.

stage.title: stage
stage.description: Current stage index (1-based), when the pull reports staged progress.

totalStages.title: total_stages
totalStages.description: Total number of stages, when known.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Image reference to pull, e.g. "alpine:3.20" or a full registry path.

platform.title: platform
platform.description: Platform to pull, e.g. "linux/arm64". Defaults to the host platform.

image.title: image
image.description: Image reference to run, e.g. "alpine:3.20". Pulled if not present locally.

name.title: name
name.description: Optional container name; becomes the container ID.

cpus.title: cpus
cpus.description: CPU limit in cores, e.g. 0.5 for half a core.

labels.title: labels
labels.description: Arbitrary metadata labels on the container.

init.title: init
init.description: Run an init process as PID 1 to reap zombies.

arguments.title: arguments
arguments.description: Command + args override (image entrypoint is used when empty).

micropod.v1.RunContainerRequest.title: RunContainerRequest
micropod.v1.RunContainerRequest.description: Shared request shape for run + create (docker run / docker create).

containers.title: containers
containers.description: Per-container stats, one entry per running container.

sampledAt.title: sampled_at
sampledAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp the snapshot was taken.

micropod.v1.StatsSnapshot.title: StatsSnapshot
micropod.v1.StatsSnapshot.description:
Single snapshot of runtime resource usage for all running containers,
 mapped from `container stats --no-stream --format json`.

id.title: id
id.description: Container ID (or name) to stream logs from.

tail.title: tail
tail.description: Number of lines to replay from the end of the log before following.

boot.title: boot
boot.description: Include the vminitd guest boot log.

diskUsage.title: disk_usage
diskUsage.description: Disk usage grouped by resource kind.

appRoot.title: app_root
appRoot.description: Path to the installed Micropod.app bundle.

apiServerVersion.title: api_server_version
apiServerVersion.description: Version of the embedded API server.

micropod.v1.SystemStatus.title: SystemStatus
micropod.v1.SystemStatus.description: Runtime health, mapped from `container system status`.

micropod.v1.Volume.title: Volume
micropod.v1.Volume.description: Curated volume, mapped from `container volume list`.
